name: telegram-trading-bot
description: Telegram bot that processes trading screenshots and executes trades on MT5

scripts.copy-dashboard: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'); const src='src/dashboard/public', dest='dist/dashboard/public'; fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest), {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync(src, dest, {recursive:true}); console.log('Dashboard files copied to dist');"
scripts.postinstall: node -e "console.log('postinstall: skipping build (use npm run build)')"
scripts.local:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=local npm run build && npm start
scripts.dashboard-only: cross-env NODE_ENV=local BOT_ENABLED=false DASHBOARD_ENABLED=true DASHBOARD_PORT=3001 npm run dev
scripts.bot-only: cross-env NODE_ENV=local BOT_ENABLED=true DASHBOARD_ENABLED=false npm run dev
scripts.web-full: cross-env NODE_ENV=local BOT_ENABLED=true DASHBOARD_ENABLED=true WEB_API_ENABLED=true npm run dev
